why: Each motor fixes an elbow on an 80 LDU circle. The endpoint is the high-Z intersection of two 160 LDU circles centred on those elbows. Because circle intersections depend nonlinearly on both angles, equal-time linear angle ramps do not generally produce a straight endpoint line.
